title: BARE HANDS STOWED SHOW NO AMMO
why: Seen on the raid screenshot of 2026-10-07: with a gun in hand, the weapon panel read STOWED  Bare Hands  0, an ammo count for fists. A stowed weapon with no magazine now shows just its name, as the held line already says MELEE for it; a stowed gun still shows its rounds.
now: The weapon panel reads STOWED  Bare Hands, without a stray 0.

edits.replacement: var _cornStow='STOWED  '+p.sec.name+((p.sec.mag>0)?'  '+p.secAmmo:'');   // v16.xx, seen on the raid screenshot (2026-10-07): bare hands read STOWED Bare Hands 0; a weapon with no magazine shows no count, as the held line says MELEE
